sources.note: Brief specifies mm geometry, N*m torque and 1 mm elements; use N and mm, so 18 N*m = 18000 N*mm.
100 mm cube in x,y,z, z up; domain [0,100]^3 with bottom z=0.
Steel is stated; assume homogeneous isotropic linear-elastic steel with E=210000 N/mm^2 and nu=0.30, since elastic constants and grade are unspecified.
Brief specifies 1 mm elements; h=1 mm.
Bottom face z=0 bolted down over its full area: fix x,y,z on entire z- face.

Brief gives four equal tangential forces on 10x10 mm top pads flush at edge midpoints. x=0 edge, footprint x=[0,10], y=[45,55], z=100. Each centroid is 45 mm from the z axis in the perpendicular direction; F=18000/(4*45)=100 N in -y, giving +4500 N*mm about z per pad. Net force zero; total Mz=+18000 N*mm.

Brief gives four equal tangential forces on 10x10 mm top pads flush at edge midpoints. x=100 edge, footprint x=[90,100], y=[45,55], z=100. Each centroid is 45 mm from the z axis in the perpendicular direction; F=18000/(4*45)=100 N in +y, giving +4500 N*mm about z per pad. Net force zero; total Mz=+18000 N*mm.

Brief gives four equal tangential forces on 10x10 mm top pads flush at edge midpoints. y=0 edge, footprint x=[45,55], y=[0,10], z=100. Each centroid is 45 mm from the z axis in the perpendicular direction; F=18000/(4*45)=100 N in +x, giving +4500 N*mm about z per pad. Net force zero; total Mz=+18000 N*mm.

Brief gives four equal tangential forces on 10x10 mm top pads flush at edge midpoints. y=100 edge, footprint x=[45,55], y=[90,100], z=100. Each centroid is 45 mm from the z axis in the perpendicular direction; F=18000/(4*45)=100 N in -x, giving +4500 N*mm about z per pad. Net force zero; total Mz=+18000 N*mm.
